pages.text: $(#2F4F4F)🐢 Ancient Shell Pact · Rooted Symbiosis 🌸$()$(br2)$(l)$(#8B4513)「Sacrificing speed to gain an impenetrable defense like millennium-old turtle shell」$()$(br)When the vitality of $(#98FB98)Emerald Lily$(), the purification of $(#EEE8AA)Moonlight Jasmine$(), the resilience of $(#32CD32)Lily of the Valley Essence$(), and the protection of $(#556B2F)Dragon Turtle Scales$() are refined within the $(#6B8E23)Ancient Tree Cauldron$()—this ultimate guardian elixir allows $(l)flesh to harmonize with the earth$().

$(#556B2F)▌ Threefold Oath of the Turtle Shell $()$(br2)$(l)$(#6B8E23)🛡 Tree-Ring Armor$()$(br)Skin develops $(#2F4F4F)cracked turtle-like textures$(), absorbing damage.$(br2)$(l)$(#98FB98)🌱 Root Healing$()$(br)Wounds slowly generate $(#32CD32)vine-like regenerative tissue$().$(br2)$(l)$(#8B4513)🌳 Earth Resonance$()$(br)All resistances become $(#556B2F)as deep-rooted as ancient trees$().$(br2)$(#808080)⚠ Natural Punishment $()$(br)$(l)$(#696969)🌿 Root Binding$()$(br)Ground sprouts $(#2F4F4F)slowing vines$() while walking.

$(br2)$(#6B8E23)▌ Ancient Brewing Method $()$(br)- Soak $(#556B2F)Scales$() in $(#98FB98)Lily Dew$() until they turn $(#32CD32)Emerald Softened$().$(br)- $(#EEE8AA)Jasmine Flowers$() must be sun-dried under $(#DAA520)noon sunlight$() until $(#FFD700)golden silk veins$() appear.$(br)- Wrap $(#32CD32)Lily of the Valley$() around $(#2F4F4F)Shell Pieces$() for $(#6B8E23)three days and nights$() during $(#8B4513)Earth Pulse Resonance$().$(br2)$(#FFD700)※$() The tea reaches perfection when $(#556B2F)tree-ring patterns$() emerge and $(#98FB98)fresh grassy fragrance$() spreads.

$(br2)$(#2F4F4F)『 Ancient Forest Inscription 』$()$(br)A moss-covered stone tablet:$(br)'Those who drink this $(#6B8E23)Earth Blood$(),$(br)shall receive:$(br)- The shell defense of $(#556B2F)Mountain Turtles$().$(br)- The slow regenerative power of $(#98FB98)World Trees$().$(br)- The elemental resistance of $(#8B4513)War Trees$().$(br)But they must endure the $(#696969)Wrath of the Forest$()—$(br)for each $(#2F4F4F)step they take$(),$(br)they shall sink into $(#32CD32)rooted marshland$(),$(br)a $(#8B4513)trial for those greedy for nature’s gifts$().'
